subject: Private offer: cross-region SKU fusion pricing and reseller net-back ask
messages:
From: Sara Khan <sara.khan@cloudbridge.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@cloudbridge.com
Date: Wed, 9 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Private offer for EU GCP SKUs + channel margin protection

Hi Olga / Ben,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team liked the latency profile. Procurement asked me to share our requirements so you can draft a private offer. High-level ask:

- Region coverage: EU-west1, EU-central1 (must be identical list price across those regions)
- SKU bundling: We want one committed bundle (reserved node-hours) that maps to multiple SKUs in the GCP catalog (see attached gcp-sku-map.xlsx)
- Discounting: Targeting a blended 28% off list across the bundle for a 12‑month commit
- Channel margin: We resell through two European VARs and need a guaranteed reseller net-back of at least 20% (post-passback) so their margins don't get squeezed
- Invoicing: Need a clear invoice path and evidence of how passback/credits will flow to the VARs for audit

Can you confirm whether Redwood can: 1) provide a single private offer that implements the bundled SKU mapping, 2) show the passback mechanics (timing and evidence), and 3) flag any tax/surcharge implications for EU invoicing?

I've attached a short spec and prelim procurement template. Procurement is on copy — they want a draft by EOD Monday (11th) to start legal review.

Sara
Head of Cloud Procurement
CloudBridge

Attachments: CloudBridge_PO_Spec.pdf

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Sara Khan <sara.khan@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Sep 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Private offer for EU GCP SKUs + channel margin protection

Sara — thanks for the clear spec, appreciate the timeline. Quick answers up front: yes, we can build a private offer that maps multiple GCP SKUs into a single committed bundle and surface a blended discount; we also support passback mechanics but need to align on the exact reconciliation cadence and evidence requirements.

Ben / Camila / Rishi — looping you in to confirm operational constraints and draft numbers. Items I want to resolve before I send a draft:

1) Passback cadence: CloudBridge wants reseller net-back realized on a monthly invoice vs. quarterly true-up? (this affects cashflow and refund timing)
2) Evidence: procurement asked for "audit evidence" — is a monthly CSV export + invoice annotation sufficient, or do our partners require separate credit memos routed to the VARs?
3) Tax handling: EU VAT / reverse-charge — finance needs to confirm which entity will issue invoices to CloudBridge vs. VARs.

I'll put together a preliminary price waterfall showing list -> committed discount -> reseller passback and include a sample invoice annotation. Rishi, can you run a quick sensitivity on 25%/28%/30% blended discount and show gross vs. net to Redwood and to the reseller at a 20% net-back? Camila, can you sketch the passback flow (how credits are applied and what docs we produce)?

I can get a draft to Sara and procurement by COB Monday if we can lock these pieces today.

—Olga
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 08:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Private offer for EU GCP SKUs + channel margin protection

Doing a first pass on passback mechanics — attaching a simple flow. Key operational notes:

- We can do monthly passback with a one-month lag (i.e., usage month Aug -> passback in Sept invoice). That meets most VAR cashflow expectations while keeping reconciliation manageable.
- Evidence set: monthly CSV of usage by reseller token, invoice annotation showing the passback line, and a PDF credit memo on request. Together these meet typical audit asks.
- Credit routing: We can route credits either via a credit memo to CloudBridge with explicit instructions for the VAR, or via direct credit memos issued to each VAR if we have their reseller account IDs on file. Direct credit memos are preferable for VAR accounting simplicity but require account onboarding.

About the 20% net-back requirement: that is achievable if the blended discount to CloudBridge stays >=28% and we hold Redwood's effective gross margin at or above our minimum threshold for the region. Rishi — I'll need your sensitivity to finalize the exact waterfall.

I'm attaching channel-passback-flow.drawio and a short checklist for reseller onboarding.

Camila
Partner Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments: channel-passback-flow.drawio

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Khan <sara.khan@cloudbridge.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Private offer for EU GCP SKUs + channel margin protection

Olga / team — I ran three scenarios (attached as gcp-sku-map.xlsx with tabs): 25% / 28% / 30% blended discount. Summary:

- 25% blended -> reseller net-back ~18% (falls short of CloudBridge ask)
- 28% blended -> reseller net-back ~20% (meets ask with the direct-credit flow; monthly-lag passback)
- 30% blended -> reseller net-back ~22% (buffer for VAT/tax or overage protections)

Operational asks before we publish the draft:
- Confirm reseller account IDs for direct credit memos (CloudBridge to provide)
- Decide on invoice annotation language (I propose: "VAR passback applied — see credit memo ref: CB-DB-87314")
- Legal to confirm whether 20% net-back should be contractual or an operational target in SOW

Sara — based on the sensitivity, recommending we publish the 28% blended private offer with the monthly-lag direct credit option (assuming you can provide reseller IDs). If procurement needs a contract-level guarantee of net-back, we should flag that to Legal — it will change our approval deck.

Next steps: Olga to send draft private offer + waterfall PDF to CloudBridge and procurement (COB Monday). Camila to prepare onboarding checklist for VARs. Ben to confirm finance VAT routing.

Thanks — Rishi
Head of Strategic Sales Ops
Redwood Inference
